objective.en: Map the deepest snow bands of the April 2018 blizzard so the city can reopen roads and check roofs.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate) + NASA Terra MODIS NDSI snow cover (GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 18% of storm-total GPM IMERG precipitation during the 13-16 April 2018 Upper Midwest blizzard, kept only where Terra MODIS NDSI shows snow on the ground afterwards (2018-04-13..2018-04-16 (IMERG), 2018-04-17..2018-04-20 (MODIS)). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its storm total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.55 for this snow setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
